CreateNewUser: INSERT INTO site.users (username, email, password_hash, role, status, phone_number, registration_date, last_login, profile_picture_id) VALUES($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9) RETURNING id;
CheckEmail: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM site.users WHERE email=$1 LIMIT 1);
IsConfirmationExpired: SELECT expires_at, confirmed FROM site.email_confirmations WHERE token = $1;
ConfirmAccount: UPDATE site.email_confirmations SET confirmed = true, confirmed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, token = NULL WHERE token=$1;
GetPasswordHashByEmail: SELECT password_hash FROM site.users WHERE email = $1;
GetAuthInfoByEmail: SELECT u.id ,u.password_hash, ec.confirmed, u.status FROM site.users u LEFT JOIN site.email_confirmations ec ON ec.user_id = u.id WHERE u.email = $1;
CreateAd: INSERT INTO site.listings (user_id, category_id, title, description, price, location_id, condition, contact_phone) VALUES($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8) RETURNING id;
GetCreateAdDependencies: SELECT (SELECT id FROM site.categories WHERE name = COALESCE($1, $2) AND (parent_id = (SELECT id FROM site.categories WHERE name = $2) OR $1 IS NULL)) AS category_id, (SELECT id FROM site.locations WHERE city = $3) AS location_id;
InsertImage: INSERT INTO site.listing_images (listing_id, image_id, position) VALUES %s;
GetAdInfo: SELECT l.title, l.price, l.created_at, l.views_count, l.condition, l.description, l.contact_phone, l.status, u.username, u.status, u.id, loc.country, loc.region, loc.city, loc.postal_code, u.profile_picture_id FROM site.listings l LEFT JOIN site.users u ON u.id = l.user_id LEFT JOIN site.locations loc ON loc.id = l.location_id WHERE l.id = $1;
GetUserRole: SELECT role FROM site.users WHERE id = $1;
GetUserData: SELECT username, email, phone_number FROM site.users WHERE id = $1
GetAdsList: SELECT l.id, l.user_id, l.category_id, c.name as category_name, l.location_id, CONCAT(loc.city, ', ', loc.region) as location_name, l.title, l.description, l.price, l.condition, l.contact_phone, l.created_at, l.updated_at, l.expiration_date, l.status, l.views_count FROM site.listings l LEFT JOIN site.categories c ON c.id = l.category_id LEFT JOIN site.locations loc ON loc.id = l.location_id WHERE l.status = 'public' ORDER BY l.created_at DESC LIMIT $1 OFFSET $2;
GetAdsCount: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM site.listings WHERE status = 'public';
GetAdsListByCategory: SELECT l.id, l.user_id, l.category_id, c.name as category_name, l.location_id, CONCAT(loc.city, ', ', loc.region) as location_name, l.title, l.description, l.price, l.condition, l.contact_phone, l.created_at, l.updated_at, l.expiration_date, l.status, l.views_count FROM site.listings l LEFT JOIN site.categories c ON c.id = l.category_id LEFT JOIN site.locations loc ON loc.id = l.location_id WHERE l.status = 'public' AND c.name = $1 ORDER BY l.created_at DESC LIMIT $2 OFFSET $3;
GetAdsCountByCategory: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM site.listings l LEFT JOIN site.categories c ON c.id = l.category_id WHERE l.status = 'public' AND c.name = $1;
GetUserChats: SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.sender_id = $1 THEN m.receiver_id ELSE m.sender_id END as user_id, u.username, m.message_text as last_message, m.created_at as last_message_time, COUNT(CASE WHEN m.receiver_id = $1 AND m.is_read = false THEN 1 END) as unread_count FROM site.messages m LEFT JOIN site.users u ON (CASE WHEN m.sender_id = $1 THEN m.receiver_id ELSE m.sender_id END = u.id) WHERE m.sender_id = $1 OR m.receiver_id = $1 GROUP BY user_id, u.username, m.message_text, m.created_at ORDER BY last_message_time DESC;
GetLikedAds: SELECT l.id, l.user_id, l.category_id, c.name as category_name, l.location_id, CONCAT(loc.city, ', ', loc.region) as location_name, l.title, l.description, l.price, l.condition, l.contact_phone, l.created_at, l.updated_at, l.expiration_date, l.status, l.views_count, (SELECT image_id FROM site.listing_images WHERE listing_id = l.id ORDER BY position LIMIT 1) as image_id FROM site.listings l LEFT JOIN site.categories c ON c.id = l.category_id LEFT JOIN site.locations loc ON loc.id = l.location_id LEFT JOIN site.user_favorites uf ON uf.listing_id = l.id WHERE uf.user_id = $1 AND l.status = 'public' ORDER BY uf.created_at DESC;
GetAdminStats: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM site.listings) as total_ads, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM site.users WHERE status = 'active') as total_users, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM site.complaints WHERE status = 'new') as pending_reports, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM site.listings WHERE status = 'moderation') as pending_moderation;
GetAllAds: SELECT l.id, l.user_id, l.category_id, c.name as category_name, l.location_id, CONCAT(loc.city, ', ', loc.region) as location_name, l.title, l.description, l.price, l.condition, l.contact_phone, l.created_at, l.updated_at, l.expiration_date, l.status, l.views_count FROM site.listings l LEFT JOIN site.categories c ON c.id = l.category_id LEFT JOIN site.locations loc ON loc.id = l.location_id ORDER BY l.created_at DESC LIMIT $1 OFFSET $2;
GetAllUsers: SELECT id, username, email, phone_number, registration_date, status, role FROM site.users ORDER BY registration_date DESC LIMIT $1 OFFSET $2;
GetComplaints: SELECT c.id, c.listing_id, c.target_user_id, c.complainant_id, c.complaint_type, c.description, c.status, c.created_at, c.updated_at, c.admin_id, c.resolution_comment FROM site.complaints c ORDER BY c.created_at DESC LIMIT $1 OFFSET $2;
GetModerationAds: SELECT l.id, l.user_id, l.category_id, c.name as category_name, l.location_id, CONCAT(loc.city, ', ', loc.region) as location_name, l.title, l.description, l.price, l.condition, l.contact_phone, l.created_at, l.updated_at, l.expiration_date, l.status, l.views_count FROM site.listings l LEFT JOIN site.categories c ON c.id = l.category_id LEFT JOIN site.locations loc ON loc.id = l.location_id WHERE l.status = 'moderation' ORDER BY l.created_at DESC LIMIT $1 OFFSET $2;
UpdateUserPassword: UPDATE site.users SET password_hash = $1 WHERE id = $2;
SearchAdsBase: SELECT l.id, l.user_id, l.category_id, c.name as category_name, l.location_id, CONCAT(loc.city, ', ', loc.region) as location_name, l.title, l.description, l.price, l.condition, l.contact_phone, l.created_at, l.updated_at, l.expiration_date, l.status, l.views_count, (SELECT image_id FROM site.listing_images WHERE listing_id = l.id ORDER BY position LIMIT 1) as image_id FROM site.listings l LEFT JOIN site.categories c ON c.id = l.category_id LEFT JOIN site.locations loc ON loc.id = l.location_id WHERE l.status = 'public'
SearchAdsCountBase: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM site.listings l LEFT JOIN site.categories c ON c.id = l.category_id LEFT JOIN site.locations loc ON loc.id = l.location_id WHERE l.status = 'public'
GetAdImages: SELECT image_id FROM site.listing_images WHERE listing_id = $1 ORDER BY position
AddToFavorites: INSERT INTO site.user_favorites (user_id, listing_id) VALUES ($1, $2) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
RemoveFromFavorites: DELETE FROM site.user_favorites WHERE user_id = $1 AND listing_id = $2;
CheckIfFavorite: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM site.user_favorites WHERE user_id = $1 AND listing_id = $2);
GetUserAds: SELECT l.id, l.user_id, l.category_id, c.name as category_name, l.location_id, CONCAT(loc.city, ', ', loc.region) as location_name, l.title, l.description, l.price, l.condition, l.contact_phone, l.created_at, l.updated_at, l.expiration_date, l.status, l.views_count, (SELECT image_id FROM site.listing_images WHERE listing_id = l.id ORDER BY position LIMIT 1) as image_id FROM site.listings l LEFT JOIN site.categories c ON c.id = l.category_id LEFT JOIN site.locations loc ON loc.id = l.location_id WHERE l.user_id = $1 ORDER BY l.created_at DESC;
UpdateUserProfile: UPDATE site.users SET username = $1, phone_number = $2 WHERE id = $3;
CreateChat: INSERT INTO site.chats (customer_id, listing_id, seller_id) SELECT $1, $2, l.user_id FROM site.listings l WHERE l.id = $2;
CreateMessage: INSERT INTO site.messages (chat_id, sender_id, message_text) values ($1, $2, $3) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
GetMessages: SELECT * FROM messages WHERE chat_id = $1 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50 OFFSET $3;
GetAdminAdsBase: SELECT l.id, l.user_id, l.title, l.created_at, u.email as user_email, l.status FROM site.listings l LEFT JOIN site.users u ON u.id = l.user_id WHERE 1=1
GetAdminAdsCountBase: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM site.listings l WHERE 1=1
UpdateUserRole: UPDATE site.users SET role = $1 WHERE id = $2;
CreateReport: INSERT INTO site.complaints (listing_id, complainant_id, complaint_type, description, status, created_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, 'pending', NOW());
GetReportsBase: SELECT c.id, c.listing_id, c.target_user_id, c.complainant_id, c.complaint_type, c.description, c.status, c.created_at, c.updated_at, c.admin_id, c.resolution_comment, u.email as complainant_email, l.user_id as ad_owner_id FROM site.complaints c LEFT JOIN site.users u ON u.id = c.complainant_id LEFT JOIN site.listings l ON l.id = c.listing_id WHERE 1=1
UpdateReportStatus: UPDATE site.complaints SET status = $1, resolution_comment = $2, admin_id = $3, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = $4;
GetUserStatus: SELECT status FROM site.users WHERE id = $1;
UpdateLastLogin: UPDATE site.users SET last_login = NOW() WHERE id = $1;
